1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6 3.Nf3 e6 4.e3 Nf6 5.Nbd2.strategy: Develops the bishop to its best diagonal, aimed at h7, and prepares to castle. It also backs up a later e4 push by the knight, so White plays for a central expansion in a solid structure.

Strikes at d4 before White has castled, trading the solid c6-support for activity. Black opens the centre and the d5-pawn may become isolated, so the move trades long-term solidity for freedom of play.
1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6 3.Nf3 e6 4.e3 Nf6 5.Nbd2.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Semmering Variation
